describes: The street test's houses (blender/parts/street/house.py): which record each is built from, the year it is seen in, the eras' working and the pack's paints, the levels with their budgets (the build fails over a budget's top), and the page every level shares. Positions are the house's own (x along its street front from its left corner, y back from the building line, z up, metres); the scene places each by its plot.

budgetSurfaceM2.describes: The surface (m², the house's charts on its page) of the house the levels' near and street budgets were set on (107, 7 x 7 m, one storey and a loft). A bigger house takes those budgets scaled by its surface, the same triangles a square metre; never less, and never more than a level's ceilingTris (a guard against a runaway house). The city level's budget is one draw a far house and is not scaled.

city.describes: The street level's pieces, each run of segments one face, without their faces in dropGroups narrower than dropNarrowerM, in neverGroups, or turned to their wall (a normal's share into it over dropFacingWall); a merged face's edge welded to the corners on it; each roof course one plane and its foot's step, each plinth one face; the street level's charts.

bake.describes: Never drawn: the roof's tiles above the near level's own, the source of the planes' baked tile relief and occlusion.

page.describes: One page a house, its charts packed at the most pixels a metre (in steps of 2) that fit between pxPerM; a roof course and the eave's undersides take less (density), and every face but the walls that face the street (their openings and plinth with them) takes `elsewhere` of it.

planeShadowDescribes: How strongly a roof's course planes shadow their baked rolls against the key light (OS_Finish's _OS_PLANE, Uncharted 4's microshadow): what the real courses get from their own cast shadows.
